2315315.text: 2315315 arrived in 2025 and already plays like a fixture near the summit: tempo and bravery both near the top, accuracy and headshots close behind them, and the lifetime ledger among the very best tracked. The kill-death record in head-to-head fights sits well above average rather than leading the card, and resistance holds a step behind the rest. A fast-rising regular with almost no soft spots.
